title: The cratylus command is each capability's one port
situation: The operator, 2026-10-26, under delegation of authority for the domain-model restructure: the concept journal holds the problem domain only, what a user observes or relies on. Delivery recorded how it works inside as concepts; those are choices of realization, recorded here so they keep binding the work once the concept leaves the design.
decision: The cratylus command as installed on a host (the runtime) runs every capability and is each capability's one port to its one implementation; a harness tool is an adapter that only calls it, so agents and the operator reach one version and no harness reimplements a capability.
consequences: Nothing changes in what is built; the choice is now read among the standing decisions instead of the design.
